# Ultime Menace — menu/state routing

**Status:** a separate experimental 4 MiB LoROM patch is generated by `tools/build_story_prototype.py`. No emulator trace has been run yet.

## Original ROM identity

- Internal title: DRAGONBALL Z3
- File size: 2,097,152 bytes
- SHA-256: 663116d015cad3398644608ca6f2506071ab23d38b03b4890e1a6caecb1a55aa
- Map mode byte: `0x30` (LoROM/FastROM)
- ROM size code: `0x0B` (2 MiB)
- SRAM size byte: `0x00` (no SRAM declared)

## Original title-to-selector path

- The title/start handler at BF:9A3C checks Start and, at file offset `0x1F9A54`, sets global state 6.
- The prototype changes the state immediate from `A9 06` to `A9 0D`, routing Start to new global state 13.
- The original three-position selector input handler is BF:AB48. It uses cursor `$196C` and limit bytes at `0x1FAB92` (`A9 02`) and `0x1FABB1` (`C9 02`).
- The original selector confirmation/setup block begins at BF:AAB7. The prototype sets `$196C` and jumps there for menu options 0-2.
- Menu option 3 enters global state 12 directly.

## Why the original FF-filled area is not used

The FF-filled range at file offsets `0x1F1806`–`0x1F8000` contains existing long-indexed references targeting BE:9806 from code at `0x00D561` and `0x00D590`. The prototype does not overwrite this range. Instead, it expands the ROM to 4 MiB and places all new data in the added LoROM banks C0-FF.

## Expanded global-state tables

The original initializer dispatcher at 80:80D1 uses a 24-bit pointer table beginning at file offset `0xF9`; it has 12 entries (indices 0-11). The original per-frame dispatcher at 80:82C5 uses a table beginning at `0x2E3` with 11 normal entries (indices 0-10).

| Structure | File offset | CPU address | Entries |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| Init table | `0x200000` | `C0:8000` | 14 (states 0-13) |
| Frame table | `0x20002A` | `C0:802A` | 14 (states 0-13) |
| New code | `0x200054` | `C0:8054` | 743 bytes |

The original initializer entries 0-11 are preserved. The frame table preserves entries 0-10, adds a default handler at index 11, then adds the story and menu handlers at indices 12 and 13.

## New UI and states

- State 12: story init/frame at C0:8054 / C0:806C.
- State 13: menu init/frame at C0:8150 / C0:816E.
- Shared PPU/DMA renderer at C0:822E.
- Font tiles: file offset `0x201000`, CPU C0:9000.
- Tilemaps: file offsets `0x202000` through `0x206800`.
- Story variables: volatile WRAM bytes `$7F:FF50`–`$7F:FF52`; no SRAM is added.
- Header ROM size code changes to `0x0C` (4 MiB); the original 2 MiB bytes remain intact except for the audited hooks and checksum/header fields.

## Original mode setup

The custom menu initializer calls the complete original submode-2 initializer BF:8104 before drawing its own UI. For options 0-2, it sets `$196C` to the selected index and jumps to BF:AAB7, which performs the original mode setup. This is a reasoned static integration path, not yet confirmed in an emulator.

## Limitations

- The menu is text-only and does not yet reproduce original menu artwork.
- The story prototype has two intro pages, a two-way choice and two short endings, but no real battle transition yet.
- 4 MiB LoROM mapping, PPU setup/DMA timing, input handling, state transitions and original mode routes require emulator testing.
